scenes.headline: How AI research agents search for better ML code
scenes.sub: AIRA: search over a graph of solutions, then fix what held it back.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Krill! AIRA is a pair of research agents from Meta that work on real machine learning competition tasks. Here's how they search.

scenes.text: A research agent is search over a graph of candidate solutions, and the operators it applies matter more than how cleverly it picks nodes.
scenes.mark: the operators it applies matter more
scenes.say: The idea: search a graph of candidate solutions, where the operators matter more than the search policy.

items.text: Select a node in the graph
items.say: Pick a candidate: greedily, by tree search, or from a population.
Apply an operator: draft, debug, improve, or cross two over.
Score it, add it, and finally submit the best. Better operators lifted even greedy search from thirty-nine point eight to forty-five point five percent.

scenes.label: medal-rate gain from picking the final submission by test score, not validation
scenes.note: the largest lever in the paper, with the search unchanged
scenes.say: But it picks its final answer by the same validation score it searched on. Picking by the true test score adds nine to thirteen points.

steps.say: The sequel keeps a population of scored candidates. An orchestrator picks a parent by rank.
It hands a mutation or crossover job to whichever GPU worker is free. Nobody waits for anyone.
Each worker runs its own reason, act, observe loop in a sandbox until the candidate is ready.
The candidate is scored in an isolated container, on a hidden search split the agent never sees.
A second hidden split is used only for the final pick. Each fix was ablated separately.

scenes.label: AIRS-Bench wins, audited by hand
scenes.note: FinQA: answers extracted from the benchmark's own GitHub repo
scenes.say: Then the authors audited their own new wins by hand. Of eleven, five used shortcuts: an answer key from GitHub, test data, or a contaminated model.

scenes.text: Operators and honest evaluation move research agents more than search tricks, and only an audit tells a real win from a shortcut.

recap: Search a graph; the operators matter most
Hidden evaluation for the final pick
Audit the wins: five of eleven were shortcuts
scenes.say: To recap: strong operators, hidden evaluation, and an audit behind every win.
